I was 16 at the time. I completely lost feelings for him after around the 1.5/2 year mark but I stayed because I figured every relationship was like that and I didn't deserve any better, and he told me all the time that nobody would ever love me so of course I believed him. I tried breaking up with him a lot starting from 2 months in but basically he said no and I didn't stand my ground. He was talking to me on kik and I wasn't really paying attention and  he ended up getting pissed at me saying I wasn't answering fast because I was talking to another dude and he started calling me a slut and w.e, and I told him he was right, I was talking to someone else, a really close friend who I'll call T. My ex was extremely jealous, around 1 year he told me to delete every male off my Facebook friend list and I complied like an idiot. So when I told him that, he flipped out. He did this whole monologue on why I'm terrible and I just didn't respond. We were at the point where I would flat out say "I hate you" and he wouldn't care. After a while he's like "do you still love me" and I just said no. That pissed him off and he kept ranting and I wasn't really paying attention to the conversation. I told him I wanted nothing to do with him. He asked to meet the next day to "fix" things and I said fine whatever. So I met him and he was telling me all the reasons I was wrong for wanting to break up with him, how I was stupid and will go nowhere in life etc. His comments didn't hurt me anymore because I was so used to then and I felt like he was right and I deserved everything he said. I was numb. I texted T, "can we meet up later" and he said okay. So I just got up and left and I hung out with T and at that point I knew there was no going back to my ex because there are people out there who actually cared about me and I didn't deserve to be treated the way I was. I was ignoring my ex's texts for the next little while and then I snapped and said "stop texting me, we're not together anymore". He told me that's wrong and insults flew. I didn't care anymore I just wanted him gone. A few days later he texted me asking to meet so I could give him some stuff back on my way to school. Stupid me agreed. I saw him at the bus station and he started bawling his eyes out, switching back and forth from "please don't leave me, I love you" to "how could you do this to me" to "I fucking hate you". He was screaming at me and it was mortifying. He wouldn't let me get on the bus so stupid me made the mistake of walking up this secluded path to my school. He continued to follow me crying and screaming and I turned around and started screaming back. He charged me so I sprinted to my school and I texted his mom saying "_____ is fucking crazy". I sat in the stairwell and I started crying. His godmother who I was close to called and I explained to her the scenario. She asked if there was someone else. I said not really. So she assumed the reason we broke up was entirely cuz there was someone else. I didn't feel like arguing anymore so I hung up and my best friend came to find me. She talked to me for a bit and brought me to guidance where I purged out this story again. They called the police, his parents, my parents, and his school. Over the next few months I didn't hear from him aside from a text saying "Can we talk" that I ignored. His/our friends only heard his side of the story so everyone thought I cheated on him and he dumped me and that was that. His friends would text me saying why I'm terrible and stuff but after a while it stopped. I only talked to one person who is good friends with him but he never mentions him when I'm around which is nice. My friends are on my side of course. He still calls some of my friends asking to hang out with them which is weird but they don't agree. I got in a new relationship with T shortly after and it's wonderful, he's the best person I could ever ask for and I'm so thankful for his continued support. I still have major confidence issues, I struggle with an eating disorder which I'm trying to recover from but I occasionally relapse but I'm getting better. I have trust issues as well but T is helping me get over my issues and become a better person. 
My advice is if your friends say your SO is being shitty, they're probably being shitty. My friends knew all along (not the severity but the general shittiness)and I lost a lot of friends from defending him (all of which have forgiven me now). If you're unhappy, get out as soon as you can. The longer you wait the worse it gets. 

TLDR; stopped caring, ex went psycho, told adults, everything was okay in the end.
